channel.title: British Comedy Guide - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from British Comedy Guide (comedy.co.uk)

item.title: Chortle Awards 2026 results
item.description: Nick Mohammed and Sam Nicoresti were both double winners at the Chortle Awards. Other winners included Ayoade Bamgboye, Catherine Cohen, Johnny White Really-Really, Esther Manito, Amy Gledhill, Tim Key and Elf Lyons.

item.title: Larry Dean to tour Hellbent show
item.description: Larry Dean: Hellbent will tour between September and December 2026.

item.title: Katherine Ryan writes a second memoir, First Born Daughter
item.description: Katherine Ryan is writing her second memoir, with First Born Daughter about the psychology and reality of being a woman, wife and daughter.

item.title: Ria Lina writes book entitled How To Erase A Woman
item.description: Ria Lina has written How To Erase A Woman, a book about how innovative women have often been removed from history.

item.title: French & Saunders reunite for Palladium panto
item.description: Comedy icons Dawn French and Jennifer Saunders will appear together in pantomime this Christmas, playing Cinderella's Ugly Sisters at The London Palladium.

item.title: Dan Clark to shoot vampire rom-com She Kills Them in London
item.description: Dan Clark is to direct his second comedy feature, with filming on vampire rom-com She Kills Them set to begin in London shortly, starring Kate Mara as a slayer of the undead trying to figure out her personal life.
